subject: qtl analysis method for dichotomous phenotype

messages.author: ae4e3267fde51265
messages.subject: qtl analysis method for dichotomous phenotype
parts:
Dr. Broman 

I just wanted to make sure that I was using the correct analysis method for an intercross with a dichotomous phenotype (0=mating with one species, 1=mating with the other species). Would I use the binary trait interval mapping with a code somewhat like this?: 

> binphe=as.numeric(pull.pheno(map_athaf2, 1) > .5 )
> map_athaf2$pheno= cbind(map_athaf2$pheno, binary=binphe)
> out.bin=scanone(map_athaf2, pheno.col="binary", model="binary")

Thank you so much!
